retrievalProfile.description: A centered, hand-drawn botanical subject against a soft, layered cloudscape with a muted, vintage-inspired color palette.

recipe.visualDefinition: A single, stylized yellow flower with a dark center stands vertically in the center of the frame. Below the main bloom, several smaller, wilting flower heads hang from the stem. The background consists of soft, painterly white and grey clouds against a pale sky, finished with a subtle paper grain texture.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical symmetry established by the central flower stem
Contrast between the upright main bloom and the drooping secondary buds
Soft, organic cloud shapes framing the sharp, dark stem
Muted primary color palette (yellow, blue, green) against a neutral grey-white base
coreInvariants: Layered cloud background with soft edges
Subtle paper-like grain texture across the entire image

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The flower is the primary subject, centered horizontally and occupying the middle two-thirds of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, circular center of the top flower serves as the focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the top bloom down the stem to the wilting buds, then upward to the typography in the upper third.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space provided by the cloud-filled sky, creating a sense of openness and airiness.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark forest green (stem and flower center)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted mustard yellow (petals) and bright cyan blue (text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high-value backgrounds and medium-value subjects.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid vibrant, high-saturation reds or oranges
Limit to a muted, earthy palette

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'K' has a distinct, hand-drawn kick
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A larger, bold hand-drawn display title paired with a much smaller, similarly styled subtitle directly beneath it.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the tall, condensed, hand-drawn feel
Provides the bold, rounded stroke quality

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a digital painting of a single mustard-yellow flower with a dark center on a dark green stem, with three wilting flower heads hanging below. The background should be a soft, painterly sky with layered white and grey clouds and a subtle paper grain texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add hand-drawn, uppercase cyan lettering in the upper center of the image. The text should have an irregular, slightly condensed sans-serif look with rounded terminals.

verificationChecks: Are the clouds soft and painterly?
Is the text color a bright cyan?
Does the image have a subtle grain texture?

mustRedesign: Exact band name and album title
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the stem is dark and thin
Check that the wilting flowers look distinct from the main bloom
Verify the text feels integrated into the hand-drawn aesthetic
Confirm the overall mood is calm and slightly melancholic
recipe.reuseFormula: Centered botanical subject + wilting secondary elements + painterly cloud background + hand-drawn display typography.
